purpose: Measure fan-out, verified completion, lossless consolidation and recovery behavior across multiple observable QIK-VRT Mesh states without transferring predecessor evidence.

human_dod_idle.formula: AUTHORITY_ALL_PRODUCTIVE_BRANCHES_MERGED and AUTHORITY_OPEN_PRS=0 and AUTHORITY_OPEN_ISSUES=0 and MIRROR_ALL_PRODUCTIVE_BRANCHES_MERGED and MIRROR_OPEN_PRS=0 and MIRROR_OPEN_ISSUES=0
human_dod_idle.reason_tree_equality_not_added: Role-local Authority/Mirror trees are observed independently unless an explicit equality effect is separately required.

scenario_matrix.description: Measure while repository backlog exists; classify explicitly as busy/non-idle.
Healthy four-node/two-pair loopback TCP Mesh with mixed opposing routes and fan-out 1,2,4,8,16.
Restart one bound node between trials, rebind its endpoint, then measure verified fan-out after recovery.
Observe fail-closed route behavior during a bounded node partition, restore the node, then measure verified fan-out after recovery.
Run only after HUMAN_DOD_IDLE is freshly established for Authority and Mirror.

final_idle_persistence.mechanism: immutable GitHub release/tag bound to exact Authority main plus Mirror main identity in receipt
final_idle_persistence.reason: Do not invalidate the zero-PR/zero-Issue idle observation merely by persisting its measurement.
